title: Development of a Predictive Model of Fetal PH At Birth from Novel Variables Derived from Cardiotocographic Tracing
official: Development of a Predictive Model of Fetal PH At Birth from Novel Variables Derived from Cardiotocographic Tracing
summary: The goal of this observational study is to build a predictive model of fetal acidosis based on variables from the cardiotocographic tracing recorded during labor in participants undergoing spontaneous or induced delivery with single pregnancy.
conditions: Pregnancies At Increased Risk of Preterm Birth
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Maternal age between 18 and 45 years;
* Single pregnancy
* Participants undergoing continuous monitoring of labor labor
* Obtaining informed consent for study participation and processing of personal data

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
